svg.text: Which amino-acid pathway genes change, and under which conditions
Each cell = one gene in one experiment, any timepoint, any paralog. Orange = significantly up, blue = down, split = up at one timepoint and down at another,
grey = measured, not significant; blank = not in that experiment's table (◆ partial tables list only significant genes); faint dot = strain lacks the gene. Significance = each paper's own call.
